_how_to_use: This ONE file decides which interactive types PageForge builds itself.

master: "all_off" = every type is left as a placeholder. "per_type" = follow the types list below (PageForge's normal setting). "all_on" = every type is built: it is never used to write modules (the harness refuses it); a switched-off type's builder is tested in memory by the builder test instead.
To switch ONE type back on: set master to "per_type", then change that type from "off" to "on". Nothing else needs editing.
A type that is off keeps its builder untouched, and its raw content is still saved to the {CODE}_interactives hand-off file.
built_notes: "drop" = a type switched on here does not repeat the writer's requests as notes after the built interactive. "keep" shows them.

version_labels.all_on: every type built (never written to the modules folder)
